transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. We've got the gala at the Orpheum on Saturday evening, and our current draft package has three cameras, festival archive reuse rights, a sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed. Before I can sign off, I need each of you — technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — to report your final operating requirements. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's on everyone's radar now since it's not currently reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue before we proceed. The signed performance license I received this morning — which is now countersigned — permits the gala broadcast, but it explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release and prohibits any later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision for festival archive reuse. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but it is binding. The archive reuse as currently drafted cannot proceed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical talent issue before we proceed. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not currently reflected in the production schedule. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision for a sponsor product display on stage.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement before we proceed. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B — its dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general control-room location currently in the plan will not work. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet.
